# GF-EQUITY-001

Independent executive-metrics oracle covering two cumulative loss years, an added capital event and an owner withdrawal.

The fixture deliberately keeps owner loans as liabilities, excludes restricted cash from runway, derives burn only from reviewed operating cash flows, and publishes project and marketing ROI as separate purpose-specific objects.

Run `node tests/fixtures/golden/GF-EQUITY-001/verify.mjs` from the repository root.
